about: Temporary stand-in stills for the rebuild/portal home page (2026-11-01), until the founder's Gemini batch 2 lands (assets/gemini-inbox/PROMPTS.md). Each id names the Gemini file it stands in for. Generated with --manifest assets/rebuild/portal.manifest.json.

defaults.stillSuffix: Photorealistic editorial photograph made to sit in one coordinated set. Colour grade: warm neutral, gentle contrast, shadows leaning toward deep pine green, natural skin tones, fine film grain, real skin texture, natural hands with five fingers. Calm and focused, never laughing, not posed like stock. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. No logos on clothing, devices, bags or buildings. No paper, notebooks, pencils or calculators. No purple, no neon, no glowing orbs, no lens flare, no sparkles. Phone and laptop screens face away from the camera.

stills.prompt: Wide horizontal frame. Two 16-year-old swimmers in plain dark team parkas sit on empty bleachers beside an indoor pool between sessions, hair still damp. One holds a phone with its back to the camera; the other leans in to look at it, both focused and quiet. Teal water and lane ropes softly out of focus below. Cool overhead light mixed with warm daylight from high windows. The two students sit in the left third of the frame; the right half is calm, uncluttered pool hall with nothing in it. Camera at seat height, 35mm lens.

stills.prompt: Vertical head and shoulders portrait of a 17-year-old student, nothing in front of him, against a deep near-black background. Over-ear headphones on, plain black t-shirt. Eyes down at a phone held at chin height in both hands, the back of the phone toward the camera. Still, intense focus, no smile. No laptop, no table. 85mm lens.
